Maya Patel: Hey folks — quick onboarding question. I just received my corp MacBook but FileVault doesn't look enabled. Wasn't sure if this is expected for contractor hires or if I missed an enrollment step.
Devon R.: Hi Maya — contractors should have FileVault enabled by default. Did you enroll in Jamf? (Check top-right MDM icon)
Maya Patel: I got the Jamf prompt but clicked postpone because I was setting up apps. Is that recoverable or should I request a reimage?
Devon R.: You can enroll now. If you want to check encryption state first run: `fdesetup status` in terminal. If it says "FileVault is On." then you're good. If not, enroll and reboot.
Maya Patel: Running `fdesetup status` now... shows "FileVault is Off" :sweat: 
Priya S.: @Maya Patel you'll need to finish the Jamf enrollment script. Follow: https://redwood-internal/docs/onboarding/mac-enroll
Priya S.: Also, contractors are exempt from MFA-only if specified in their contract. Otherwise they follow standard SSO + device policies.
Maya Patel: Thanks — enrolling now. One more thing: I received a phishing sim notice but my start date was during the sim window — will that count against me?
Devon R.: Good question. Security policy: new joiners get a 7-day grace period for mandatory training and phish sims. It shouldn't be counted as a fail as long as you complete the required training within the window.
security-bot: PHISH-SIM: Reminder sent to Maya Patel — complete phishing awareness module by 2024-11-08. https://redwood-phishsim/complete
Maya Patel: Cool. If I finish training today, do I still need to respond to the phish sim email or just mark the training done?
Priya S.: Training completion is tracked separately. If you didn't click any simulated phish links, you're fine. If you did, reply to security@redwood.ai and we can note it as new-hire incident handling.
Liam C.: Also ping us in #eng-oncall if you hit any Jamf errors during enrollment — we can remote into the device.
Maya Patel: Enrollment succeeded, FileVault turned on after reboot. Thanks everyone! :tada:
Devon R.: Awesome — welcome aboard Maya. If anything else pops up DM me.
Priya S.: Welcome! We'll mark phishsim grace applied.
Maya Patel: Appreciate it! I'll finish the training tonight.
